Wondering how the game has progressed from about half a year or so ago.

I know there are two free expansions coming, not sure what that includes. I'm hoping it has a good amount of PvE content though.

I haven't played since they released the 3rd DLC, although I intend to once I reactivate my psplus. For each DLC they release (I didn't buy any) they release some free content with it.

PvE at the higher end, enemies are not as tanky as they were initially but they added new AI (they tend to rush or flank you more) to keep it challenging. The shotgunners are not also snipers any more but sometimes you can run into large groups of them and they can mess up your team.

Missions have hard, challenging and some have Heroic. While the overall mission is the same, on Heroic there are different enemies and they use different tactics than the lower difficulty settings. Also they can one shot you if they run up to you and bash you so you have to keep your distance and keep in cover/work as a team with revives etc. Personally I like to make the enemies rush into doorways or narrow areas where the snipers etc can't reach you and where you have better cover. Heroic missions also have 1 checkpoint, if your team dies before you reach that you start over from the beginning of the mission (approx 20-30 mins of time lost). They changed revive times from 3-5 seconds and while that doesn't seem like much, on heroic difficulty it makes a huge difference.

They added tiers to lvl 30 (Tiers 1 through 5), I just wish they would of added more tiers. They have 16 free roam bosses you can kill for 2 drops each. I used to run through all 16 in about 40 minutes and you can redo every 3 hours or maybe it was 6, I forget exactly. Or just switch to a 2nd character and rinse repeat for a plenty of loot to go through. You can also randomly get drops from almost any kill, except in incursions I believe. So doing by doing the side missions you still get loot. You also have to complete them all per district for the intel missions. They added Intel missions (you collect intel, then use that to "Purchase" a multi-wave boss fight scenario and gets a bunch of drops. The daily ones can be retried if you fail, the weekly can not be retried but can be repurchased. I've done some of the weekly ones solo, so they are not terribly difficult but there isn't a reason to do it solo unless you really want to for the challenge. Better with friends cause you can share your drops now. You have 1 hour to drop something that you can trade only with your group from the time you loot it.

I rarely go into the dark zone on my main character, I dislike the PvP in the game. They added 3 more dark zone areas with a lot more interior building areas and alleys (I went through and explored it once). However, sometimes I take a 2ndary character just to screw around. I believe they discontinued any xp loss when dieing in the dark zone but I still don't like it. There are occasionally air drops in the dark zone (with a boss and limited time; 5 minutes I think) that you can loot and you do not have to extract. Other players loot can be cut from an extracting helicopter(makes you rogue). You can gear yourself towards PvE or PvP by focusing on different stats and there is a Dark zone gear set - Banshee. That's probably why I don't care for it so much. (I'm PvE geared).

Gear sets are nice depending on what type of tactics you want to use (look at the 2, 3 and 4 gear set bonuses) and you can mix and match, (2, 2 and 2, 3 and 3 or 4 and 2) and there is also rare named non gear set armor and named weapons that drop. Personally normally run with 2 Alphabridge and 4 Nomad for the healing effects/regen). I usually keep several gear sets so I can switch up abilities and such with different kinds of groups. Plenty of loot to collect but I played it so much I was to the point where I would practically sell every loot drop for money (even rare stuff- I think I've looted over a dozen Medveds) with 1 drop every 10 hrs of game play or so that I would keep as it was EVER so slightly higher stats or a mod I wanted. I have several of the rare named non gear set armor pieces, 2 full armor set worth I think and 4 or 5 of the Ferro Mask (can still shoot while on fire). You can also by paying a lot of in game money or phoenix credits, re-calibrate armor stats or weapon stats, though you can only pick one stat to change you can re-roll several times on weapons and limitlessly on armor (costing more each time). For weapons you need and weapon re-calibration kit but they drop from enemies a lot, I have 99 (the max) almost at all times. They upped the max number of phoenix credits you can carry from 2k to 5k I think. If you have extra credits you can buy kits that give you random armor/gearset/weapon/mods depending on what you pick from the vendor. Stash size was increase too.

Overall for PvE tons of loot to find, gear sets to collect, rares to loot and more fun on missions and incursions. I haven't played in over a month or so, so any new changes I am unaware of.
